title: ee.team.manifest_event.v1
$comment: DRAFT — pre-implementation artifact for bd-tc-epic-qzk7o.3.1 (T2.0), encoding the AUTHORITATIVE 2026-07-30 override: manifests are NOT ee.mesh.event.v1 create/revise records, there are NO mem_team logical IDs, and requiredFeatures is not used to smuggle a closed memory schema. Manifest operations have their own typed vocabulary and travel INLINE in the metadata lane within the payload budget — never via body_fetch, otherwise the default-deny body lane would block manifest replication. Operation vocabulary is finalized by T4.1 (the materializer); NOT registered, NOT emitted yet.
description: Typed team-manifest payload of an origin event: membership, node bindings, project records, and lane-profile documents. Member removal is a typed operation at this level (memory tombstone keeps its memory semantics). The T4.1 materializer projects these deterministically with conflict and removal-cutoff rules; T2.8 rematerialization replays them after fork rollback.

operation.$comment: TBD final vocabulary (T4.1 owns the materializer); one logical document per member record, node binding, project record, and lane-profile document.

documentId.description: Random opaque document identity (one per logical manifest document); never derived from names, emails, hostnames, or paths.

documentPayload.description: Inline metadata-lane manifest content, bounded by the payload budget. Pending invite/join state carries hashes and non-secret phases only — no clear bearer secret ever appears here (T3.1).
